name: Taretha's Gift
summary: Elysa gives up Taretha's Gift and asks for peace. After the step with Lord Aliden Perenolde, you carry the pendant to Krusk in Tarren Mill.

sections.title: The Pendant
sections.body: Elysa wants no memory of Lord Aliden Perenolde. She gives you the pendant and asks only to be left in peace. It once belonged to Taretha Foxton, Thrall's childhood friend. You carry it to Krusk in Tarren Mill, returning it to the orcs.

sections.title: Krusk's Verdict
sections.body: Krusk finds it strange that the Warchief would go to such lengths for a trinket. He does not claim to understand Thrall, but follows his orders all the same. Krusk praises your work and expects Thrall will be pleased to hear of it.

aliases: where do you get taretha's necklace
faq.answer: Elysa gives up the necklace without argument. She wants no memory of Lord Aliden Perenolde and asks only to be left in peace.

faq.q: To whom must the necklace be returned?
aliases: where do i bring the pendant
faq.answer: Bring it to Krusk, who waits at Tarren Mill.

aliases: why does thrall want the pendant
faq.answer: The pendant belonged to Taretha Foxton, Thrall's childhood friend. Returning it gives the orcs a keepsake of hers.

faq.q: What comes before this in the chain?
faq.answer: The step involving Lord Aliden Perenolde comes before this. This is the last part of the chain.
